about.title: About Me
about.profile:
EPF engineer, I started in data and cloud (Big Data, dashboards, automation) before specialising in cybersecurity.

I am now a work-study in the Cybersecurity (ISS) department of SFR Business, working on GRC: NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001 and 27005 compliance, audit preparation, security in projects, awareness and tracking dashboards. In parallel, ESIEA's CISIS MSc trains me on the technical side: web and application vulnerabilities, cryptography, malware analysis.

comfyui.title: ComfyUI Pipeline
comfyui.subtitle: Modular image, video and 3D reconstruction generation pipeline built around ComfyUI.
howToSteps: Download the models (.safetensors) and place them in the correct models/ folders
Drag the .json file onto the ComfyUI canvas — or load a ComfyUI-generated PNG image (the workflow is embedded)
Use ComfyUI Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes to install any missing nodes
Click Queue Prompt to start generation
comfyui.howToApiTip: Tip: "Save (API format)" exports a JSON you can POST to /prompt for automation.
comfyui.safeSourcesSafetensors: Always prefer .safetensors format — it cannot execute code, unlike .ckpt/.pt/.bin (pickle-based).

safeSourcesList.name: Hugging Face
safeSourcesList.tip: Download from official organizations (black-forest-labs, Comfy-Org, microsoft). Check the file's security scan status before downloading.

safeSourcesList.name: Civitai
safeSourcesList.tip: Download .safetensors only. Check reviews and download counts. Avoid .ckpt files.

safeSourcesList.name: ComfyUI Registry
safeSourcesList.tip: Install custom nodes through ComfyUI Manager or the Registry — review the source repo before installing (nodes run arbitrary Python).

comfyui.safeSourcesHashTip: Compare the SHA256 hash when published to verify file integrity.

scene.illustrative: Illustrative visualisation — no model is run.

captions.t2i: The initial noise resolves into an image step by step; too high a CFG oversaturates and over-contrasts it.
captions.i2v: A video is a stack of images over time: the shape moves from frame to frame, and RIFE inserts in-between frames.
captions.i3d: The image becomes a sparse voxel cloud, which converges into a shape and then a solid mesh.
